verdict.rationale: Docs show core telephony workflow: creating an assistant, connecting/provisioning phone numbers, and making calls via API/CLI/dashboard (vapi-docs-1, -18, -19), plus SIP-based inbound/outbound call testing (vapi-docs-14, -22, -40) and MCP/CLI management of phone numbers and calls (vapi-docs-2, -5, -33, -37). Community evidence corroborates working call demos (vapi-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a dedicated 'buy/provision phone number' API endpoint and independent verification of outbound calling specifically (beyond inbound demo).
